title: the cast door reads a plan of outcomes, refuses one with no claim or more than seven, and publishes one plan view
intention: cairn/tools/base reads both plan shapes through one published view (cairn.tools.base.plan), and the cast door admits a plan of outcomes: each outcome {n, claim, writes_to, reads, after, via?} numbered 1..k, no separate falsifier. It refuses an outcome with no claim, a plan of more than seven outcomes, and a plan carrying both shapes. BUILDME holds while any outcome awaits its claim.
why: Measured 2026-11-14: Q#100 is answered and the plan becomes outcomes (outline 9.3.5.1.2.1); this component reads ticket plans, so by RULE 1 its dual-read is its own ticket, a sibling of aa3e9a70db47 (the migration).
traces_to: Law 5 (the plan carries what a builder needs now), RULE 1 (each reader changes inside its own component); outline 9.3.5.1.2.1.
how: Dual-read during the change: this ticket publishes the view the readers compose.

clauses.claim: a doc whose plan is outcomes (each with a claim, numbered 1..k, no falsifier, no decisions) casts, and the plan file carries them as written
a doc with an outcome lacking a claim, one with 8 outcomes, and one carrying outcomes beside decisions are each refused with that lack named, and nothing lands
plan.clauses and plan.steps read an outcomes plan and an old decisions+falsifier plan to the same {n, claim} and {n, text, writes_to, reads} lists for the same content
a BUILDME crossing of a ticket carrying an outcome with no claim is refused by every_outcome_has_its_claim; the same ticket with the claim given passes that lane
a retired line logged against an outcomes plan rejoins `outcomes` on read, in n order

decisions.text: D1: new module cairn/tools/base/plan.py, the one plan view every reader composes: clauses(doc), steps(doc) and awaiting(doc) (the n of each outcome with no claim). A plan with `outcomes` reads from them; otherwise from falsifier.clauses and decisions, as today. The base charter's public_interface names the module.

D2: transitions._shape_lacks reads `outcomes` by the charter's plan_shapes: each {n: int, claim: non-blank, writes_to and reads path lists (reads resolve), after: list of outcome numbers or 12-hex ticket ids, via: optional string}, numbered 1..k. cast_ticket refuses, naming each: an outcome with no claim (awaiting judgement is the migration's state, never a cast's); more than 7 outcomes (the outline's ~7, one constant), naming 'too big: split into children'; and `outcomes` beside `decisions` or `falsifier`. falsifier stops being required when `outcomes` is present. Refusals ride the existing CastRefused path, so they are recorded.
D3: a BUILDME entry lane every_outcome_has_its_claim, beside the_ticket_has_every_answer_it_needs, refuses the crossing while plan.awaiting(ticket) is non-empty.
D4: ticket_log's retired-line rejoin (read, ~line 254) rejoins into `outcomes` when the plan carries them, else `decisions`.
D5: the store charter's plan_shapes gains `outcomes` and `constraints` (a list of non-blank strings, each a how carried verbatim), and its plan_fields gain `outcomes`, `constraints` and `resources`.
D6: the red-first proof casts into a scratch commons, one tooth per clause.

D7: the four proofs that pin the BUILDME entry lanes at exactly five count six, with every_outcome_has_its_claim between the answers lane and the outline lane (forced by D3). Two of them sit in build_inspector and rehearsal: they assert base's lane list, which is a reach across RULE 1 standing in those proofs, not one this ticket adds.

out: the migration itself and rehearsal's reader (aa3e9a70db47)
every other reader component (their own sibling tickets)

measured.saw: Akien answered Q#100 (open-7aee6f89e4d9, open-82f27105184f): "rather than tasks should we be focused on outcomes?" ... "yes, we're in agreement. signed -amm". Outline 9.3.5.1.2.1: a plan is constraints, then outcomes {n, claim, writes_to, reads, after, via?}, then resources; the falsifier's clauses merge into the outcomes (old clause n stays outcome n); during the change every reader accepts both shapes, one sibling ticket per reader component.
measured.how: his answer, relayed verbatim by orchestrator; recorded at the question door; outline 9.3.5.1.2.1

measured.saw: the build at 8e8ca621d wrote four proofs outside bounds.in: each asserted exactly five BUILDME entry lanes and read six once D3's lane joined; all four green at six
